buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Malicious Code Certificate:

The seller should upload following certificate in the bid:- (a) This is to certify that the Hardware and the Software being offered, as part of the contract, does not contain Embedded Malicious code that would activate procedures to :- (i) Inhibit the desires and designed function of the equipment. (ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 6. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 7. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.2D & 3D Layout of E-Rickshaw A detailed 2D and 3D layout/drawing of the proposed E-Rickshaw shall be provided, incorporating all specifications, dimensions, equipment, components, and safety provisions/ plac ements as specified in the Bid/RFP The drawings shall clearly indicate: i. Overall dimensions and internal layout of the E-Rickshaw. ii. Placement and mounting of all equipment and accessories. iii. Passenger/operator seating arrangement. Battery and electrical component placement. iv. Safety features and protective arrangements. v. Storage compartments and securing mechanisms. vi. Adequate accessibility for operation, inspection and maintenance. 2. Customized 3D Layout of E-Rickshaw A detailed 3D layout/rendering of the customized E-Rickshaw shall be submitted, demonstrating the propo sed modifications and utilization of available space. The E-Rickshaw shall be customized as follows: A. Complete Branding & Covering The vehicle shall be fully covered as per the requirements of the Organiz ation. Provision shall be made for displaying the Organization's Logo and Name etc. Branding shall be prof essionally executed without obstructing visibility, ventilation, safety equipment, lights, indicators or statut ory markings. B. Customized Storage & Equipment Arrangement The vehicle shall have dedicated and properly secured arrangements for safe transportation/storage of the following:

1. Drone – 01 No. Dedicated, secure storage space for the drone. Suitable cushioning/protection against m ovement and damage during transportation. 2. Battery – 04 Nos. Dedicated battery storage compartment. Proper securing and protection against accid ental movement. Safe placement considering electrical and fire-safety requirements. 3. Drone Charger – 01 No. Dedicated and secured space for the charger and associated accessories. Provisi on for organized cable/accessory storage. 4. Agro-Chemicals Separate, secured and appropriately ventilated storage arrangement as required. The st orage area shall be physically segregated from the operator/pilot seating area and other equipment. Suita ble containment/protection shall be provided to prevent leakage or spillage during transportation. 5. Drone Pilot – 01 Person properly designed and ergonomically suitable seating arrangement for one dron e pilot. Adequate legroom, headroom and safe access/egress. Seating shall not interfere with the storage o f the drone, batteries, charger or agro-chemical containers. C. Safety & Functional Considerations The proposed 2D/3D design shall demonstrate that all customized e quipment and storage arrangements are: Properly secured against movement during transit. Designed to maintain vehicle stability and weight distribution. Easily accessible to the authorized operator. Separated appropriately where required for safety. Protected against accidental contact, damage or spillage. Compat ible with the E-Rickshaw's electrical and mechanical systems. In compliance with all applicable safety requ irements and the specifications stipulated in the Bid /RFP. The bidder shall submit the final 2D drawings, 3 D model/renderings and detailed layout showing the exact placement of the drone, two batteries, charger , agro-chemical storage and one drone pilot seating arrangement. 4. Bidder should delivery items on FOR basis. 5. ICCMRT shall be paid a minimum service charge/fees of 2% of the bid value by the Drone Supplier . 6 . All drones along with batteries and other equipments /components should have Mandatory 03 Years Co mprehensive Onsite Warranty & 01 Year Comprehensive Third Party Insurance cover after completion of S uccessful Commissioning & Testing of Drones at delivery location with responsibility /setting any claim wit h the underwriter in bidders scope. 7. For E-Rickshaw :- 2Year warranty/maintenance and 1 Year Comprehensive and Third Party Insurance Re quired. 8. Bidder has to upload compliance, datasheet and catalogue with required 2D/3D drawings etc. 9.Bidder has to submit GST, PAN, Work orders, Completion certificate, work orders. 10.Payment shall be released after successful delivery, installation, and training, subject to the release of f unds by the concerned Uttar Pradesh Government Department. 11.Bidders can be called for demo of drone etc. 12.Bidder shall be considered for MSE exemptions as per GeM GFR rule except EMD. EMD IS MANDATORY. 13.The quantity of the items to be supplied may increase or decrease subject to availability of funds. . 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of DIRECTOR ICCMRT payable at LUCKNOW . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG

Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name ICCMRT Account No. 50100337473951 IFSC Code HDFC0003941 Bank Name HDFC BANK Branch address Sector 15,Munshipulia,Indiranagar,Lucknow,U.P . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid.
